title: What Happens If You Jump Into Jupiter? #Shorts
description:
If you jumped into Jupiter wearing a spacesuit, you would not land on a surface. Jupiter is a gas giant with no solid ground. You would free-fall through freezing ammonia clouds at over one hundred thousand miles per hour. Within minutes, the atmospheric pressure would equal being buried under thousands of miles of ocean, crushing you instantly before reaching molten diamond rain.
